title: Package 78 Staged Re-equilibration Independent Evaluation and Gate C1-1 Decision
finding: Package 78 solver evidence independently evaluated: Step 1 state injection matched donor RF within 0.0588% (3.268 N vs 3.266 N) and fracture energy within 0.2033% (293.33 uJ vs 293.92 uJ). Step 2 mechanical relaxation completed 100% (6 increments, 1 iteration each) relaxing elastic energy from 24.57 uJ to 14.87 uJ while strictly preserving damage energy (Delta d = 0). Step 3 unconstrained coupled release reduced max displacement corrections by >2,700,000x (0.087 um vs 242 mm in Package 77) and preserved fracture energy within 0.1199% of donor across 11 converged increments before time cutback (dt < 1e-8). Gate C1-1 strictly FAILED due to 1724 healing nodes (min Delta d = -0.004259), incomplete step time (t = 0.0631), and reaction force deficit.
next_operation: Formulate and test bounded phase-field irreversibility constraint or stabilization hypothesis for unconstrained coupled re-equilibration under Method C Gate C1-1
